title: Sum of Square Numbers
summary: Determine if there exist two integers a and b such that the sum of their squares equals a given non-negative integer c.
statement: Determine if there exist two integers a and b such that the sum of their squares equals a given non-negative integer c.
constraints: Return true when two nonnegative integers a and b satisfy a² + b² = c.
hints: The sum increases with the smaller pointer and decreases with the larger pointer.
Start at zero and the integer square root, then move one bound at a time.
Compare left²+right² with c; increase left if low, otherwise decrease right.
Monotonic movement eliminates an entire row or column of candidate pairs at each step.
editorial: Monotonic movement eliminates an entire row or column of candidate pairs at each step.

tests.explanation: One squared plus two squared equals five.
No pair of integer squares sums to three.
